notes: The Imdex 5: the code of launch 1668 with the changes its audits asked for, deployed as a new contracts-only launch on Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1). One contract, Imdex5 (src/Imdex5.sol), whose own ERC-20 share is 'The Imdex 5' (IMDEX5, 18 decimals, plain transfers, supply 0 at deployment, no cap; a mint issues, a redeem burns, nothing else mints). No launch token, pool or website. The constructor takes no arguments, calls no contract and checks no code length; it seeds the five-coin starting list (1282 INFER, 1283 MARG, 737 ZTO, 1075 SCAT, 1175 SwarmCity 0x1ae93A4D9CC0b41C594D00387B6F832a88f729b7, with the hooks of launch 1668) and sets listCount to 5. Every chain value is a constant: IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7, Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, registries 0xA47FcB220DDd1cDddA865F89029BEc1b9EcA3bf1 and 0x7c9D5ee697BfF5Ac4F10E2E54d3f40c44e48fE23, Intake 0xa43e6F75ee006411F79Ac1C84120606C2330DE82 with action oracle.request@oracle-1 at 0.5 IMD, oracle signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982 (EIP-712 domain 'IdentityMD Oracle' version 2 bound to this chain and this contract), pool fee 12500, tick spacing 60. There is no owner, admin, role, setting, pause or upgrade, so no $owner argument exists and nothing is assigned to the factory or IMD. Anyone calls everything: fund, mintFirst, mint, redeem, redeemToImd, claim, ask, submit, rebalance and closeRequest; onOracleResult and onOracleFailure accept only the Intake; unlockCallback only the PoolManager; swapSelf only the contract itself. Unchanged from launch 1668: the 0.50% fee on mints, redeems and redeemToImd into feeImd (which pays only the 0.5 IMD oracle price and the 0.25 IMD caller rewards), idleImd, redeem in kind with failed transfers recorded as owed and claimable, redeemToImd, fund, the weekly ask, the on-chain question, the 25% weight cap and the 2% price stops; held[coin] is the balance increase measured around PoolManager.take, so it always equals what really arrived. Changes made here and listed in README.md: (1) mint(shares, maxImdIn, minShares) reverts TooFewShares when fewer than minShares shares would be issued, every buy rolls back and the buyer keeps every IMD; (2) audit 886e7c22, all fixed: a residual coin (one that left the list and could not yet be sold) whose pool trades but fills short never blocks mint, the shortfall is charged at the price that pool just traded at into the holders' idle IMD (medium); submit checks the attestation's validity window (low); submit reads the quorum, at least 4 agreed, from the signed attestation (low); the last holder pays no fee on redeemToImd either (low); (3) audit 3bd5e1aa (medium), fixed: a residual whose buy reverts outright is a failed buy, the mint reverts BuyFailed(coin) and takes nothing, instead of being settled at a spot price the minter could move in the same block; the short-fill path is unchanged. Low and informational findings (be08f42a, 4acb1b2e, 57e3696c, f094a9a7, 357a7068) are documented in README.md and THREAT_MODEL.md, not redesigned. Compiled with solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200 runs, via_ir, cancun, bytecode_hash none; runtime measured 23,266 bytes, under 24,576, with no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. Local check: forge build and forge test with the verifier fuzz seed pass (145 tests; the 7 mainnet fork tests skip without a fork URL).
